_readme: The Gallery page + the 'Recent work' row on Home. featuredId: the id of the portrait shown large on Home (must match an id below). Each piece: id (unique, no spaces), title (pet's name), category (Dogs / Cats / Artwork / Ornaments), ratio (width ÷ height of the image), thumb + full (paths under /paintings/). To add a portrait see CONTENT.md. TODO(pre-launch): replace placeholder titles Scout/Marmalade/Blue/Cocoa with the real pet names.

pieces.title: Twins
pieces.alt: Hand-painted acrylic portrait of two tabby kittens with bright green eyes, side by side on a gray background flecked with hot pink, held up in the artist's hand.

pieces.title: Pumpkin Stitch
pieces.alt: Hand-painted acrylic portrait of a black French bulldog in a pumpkin costume with a green stem hat, on a blue background with red-orange brushstrokes.

pieces.title: Franky
pieces.alt: Hand-painted acrylic portrait of a small white dog with black ears dressed as Frankenstein's monster, with a green face, black flat-top hair, neck bolts, and stitches, on a hot pink background.

pieces.title: Luna
pieces.alt: Hand-painted acrylic portrait of a green-eyed tabby cat lying on a blue cushion with its paws over the edge, wearing a blue evil-eye charm, on a gray and pink background.

pieces.title: Boey
pieces.alt: Two hand-painted round wood-slice ornaments on red ribbons: a portrait of a tan-and-white dog with a pink nose and green collar on a blue background, and a dotted paw print with snowflakes and the name “Boey” over 2026.

pieces.title: Rocky
pieces.alt: Two hand-painted round wood ornaments on twine loops: a rainbow-dotted paw print with the name “Rocky” on hot pink, and “2026” in white on green.

pieces.title: Rocky
pieces.alt: Expressive acrylic portrait of a dog named Rocky, painted in bold brushstrokes.
